# v0.5.0 preregistered scientific validation

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

## Reference and limits

The reference is complete distinct canonical k-mer-set containment. Both exact and
estimated containment are transformed to displayed `ANI_c=C^(1/k)` before error is
computed. `ANI_c` is not biological ANI or alignment-derived `ANI_m`. Controlled point
substitution fixtures are the only biological mutation-rate comparison; large indels
are estimator-robustness fixtures evaluated against exact containment.

The release-blocking limits were recorded before execution:

| Tier | Mean absolute `ANI_c` | P95 absolute `ANI_c` | Combined 0.80 floor crossings |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 256-register preview, fixed browser hash | 0.050 | 0.300 | 10% |
| 256-register preview, four-layout aggregate | 0.080 | 0.300 | 10% |
| 1,024-register detail | 0.010 | 0.040 | 5% |

Crossings at 0.85, 0.90, and 0.95 remain diagnostics. Preview has no maximum-error
gate. Sparse correction is disabled.

## Grid

The selected production configurations were evaluated over four sequence realizations
and four deterministic ntHash2 validation layouts. Inputs cover controlled 99%, 90%,
85%, and 80% point-substitution cases; 12-base periodic and 257-base tandem repeats;
ambiguity; a 4 kb insertion and deletion; a 16 kb inversion; a 4 kb coordinate offset;
and a 4:1 cardinality ratio. Each 12 by 12 matrix uses the exact containment oracle.

The aggregate results are retained in [scientific-grid.tsv](scientific-grid.tsv). Both
tiers pass all release-blocking limits. Observed 32-bit verified-winner fingerprint
collisions were zero. Zero inflation, holes, isolated false pixels, continuity, local
error, neighboring-error correlation, top-feature overlap, components, occupancy,
bias, variance, and comparison time are reported rather than hidden by the aggregate
accuracy gates.

## Selective scheduler

Scheduler policy 2 was characterized on controlled 99% and 90% point-substitution
comparisons and a 90% periodic-repeat comparison. The initial preview retained at least
80% of exact cells at or above `ANI_c` 0.85 as coherent visible structure. The final
selective mosaic met mean/P95 disagreement limits of 0.030/0.100 against all-detail
output and allowed at most 2% of valid cells to cross the 0.80 floor. Visible
corrections completed before the last selected tile in every fixture.

The scheduler refined 63 of 108 tiles, or 58.3% of the corresponding all-detail work.
This is a 41.7% work reduction; it is not presented as a universal wall-clock speedup.

## Fingerprint expectation

For occupancy `o`, the conservative expected unequal-winner verification collisions
per cell are `2 * registers * o^2 / 2^32`. The measured aggregate expectations were
`1.192e-7` per preview cell and `4.732e-7` per detailed cell. Even the saturated
worst-case fraction at 1,024 registers is below `4.77e-7` of cells: about 0.477 expected
events in a 1,000 by 1,000 matrix and 7.63 in a 4,000 by 4,000 matrix. One collision is
only one register vote, so expected display impact is not material enough to justify a
wider-fingerprint benchmark in this release.

Run the grid with:

```text
cargo test --release --features validation -p moddotplot-core --test estimator_validation report_v0_5_preregistered_production_grid -- --ignored --nocapture
```
